text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear stance in opening: \"I for one am really excited\"","quality":"claim clarity","description":"It states a definite position early so the reader immediately knows the writer's argument."},{"evidence":"\"I do understand why some are spectical about them though\"","quality":"acknowledgment of counterargument","description":"It shows awareness that there are opposing concerns rather than arguing as if no disagreement exists."},{"evidence":"\"the car could malfunction or doing something the person may not understand or like\"","quality":"reasoned support","description":"It offers a specific objection that helps explain why someone might hesitate about driverless cars."},{"evidence":"opening and closing connect excitement to future benefits","quality":"coherence","description":"Its ideas follow a recognizable line of reasoning from opinion to support to conclusion."},{"evidence":"\"one day we will al, have these very special future cars\"","quality":"concluding projection","description":"It ends with a forward-looking conclusion that reinforces the writer's overall position."}]}
